summary: Iteration 52 re-test after E1's persistence fix for tuner_feature_names + tuner_selected_mask in improved_ai_ml_system._save_model/_load_model and maximized_ai_ml_system._save_model/_load_model. Cold backend restart + ran /app/backend/tests/test_iteration52_overlay_ml_voting.py end-to-end. ALL 11/11 TESTS PASS, including the previously failing P2 ML voting tests. Tuner attrs survive cold restart (improved: 84 names / 70 mask, maximized: 84 names / 70 mask). Direct curl of POST /api/signals/force-generate-v2 confirms components.improved_ml_v2 and components.maximized_ml_v3 are wired with OTC-aware weighting that exactly matches base_w * accuracy/100.
critical_code_review_comments: Persistence fix in improved_ai_ml_system._save_model and maximized_ai_ml_system._save_model is correctly storing tuner_feature_names + tuner_selected_mask in the pickle dict; _load_model correctly restores them post cold restart (verified: 84 feature names, 70-True mask in both models).
force-generate-v2 is POST-only (returns 405 on GET). The test correctly falls back from GET to POST. Worth documenting in OpenAPI/route docstring so consumers don't hit 405.

ML voting weights match the documented formula exactly (base_weight * model_accuracy/100): OTC improved=4.0*0.571=2.284 (got 2.28), OTC maximized=2.0*0.5495=1.099 (got 1.10), non-OTC improved=2.5*0.571=1.4275 (got 1.43), non-OTC maximized=3.0*0.5495=1.6485 (got 1.65). Within ±0.01 of expected.
OTC vs non-OTC weighting inversion behaves correctly: improved dominates on OTC (2.28 > 1.10), maximized dominates on non-OTC (1.65 > 1.43).
test_credentials: testuser / test123 (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md, not exercised in this iteration)
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral OTC candle rows tagged with TEST_ITER52_<uuid>_OTC symbols; idempotency test re-sends same timestamps — total of 5 candles per fresh symbol. Trade rows for asset='TEST_ITER52_REG' inserted via /api/trades/report and /api/trades/outcome.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 52 ML voting persistence fix is confirmed end-to-end. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration52_overlay_ml_voting.py is the canonical regression for: (a) live OTC overlay tagging via /api/signals/collect-otc-candles, (b) /api/signals/otc-candle-stats summary fields (po_live_candles, oanda_backfill_candles, overlay_ratio), (c) idempotent upserts on (symbol, timestamp) collisions, (d) force-generate-v2 ML components with OTC-aware weighting, (e) /api/ml/tuning-report shows both improved_v2 and maximized_v3 trained, (f) regression for /api/trades/report, /api/trades/outcome, /api/signals/win-rate-stats, /api/ml/backfill-otc-from-oanda. Note: BASE_URL must be set via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when running pytest (export $(grep -v '^#' /app/frontend/.env | xargs) or use a conftest auto-loader). force-generate-v2 is POST-only (GET returns 405); the test handles this with a GET->POST fallback.
rca of the issue: PRIOR ISSUE (iter 49): tuner_feature_names + tuner_selected_mask were attached to the model instance at training time but NOT included in the pickled _save_model dict, so a cold backend restart loaded the .pkl without them and predict_with_tuner_pipeline silently failed the column-alignment step, dropping ML components from force-generate-v2 output. FIX (iter 52, applied by E1): both improved_ai_ml_system._save_model (L654-668) and maximized_ai_ml_system._save_model (L876-890) now include tuner_feature_names + tuner_selected_mask in the pickle dict, and the corresponding _load_model methods (L678-693 and L900-913) restore them onto self. Models retrained after the fix landed; .pkl files now contain the keys. VERIFIED post cold restart: both attrs present and non-empty (84 names, 70 mask), and components.improved_ml_v2 + components.maximized_ml_v3 appear in force-generate-v2 response with weights exactly matching base_w*accuracy/100 formula. All 11 tests pass.
